State side: NPCSC 18th session 2025-10-28 决定任命张升民为中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席，免去何卫东的中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席职务 (https://www.news.cn/politics/leaders/20251028/720677a97a7f46b6a9eb1b9e724bbb55/c.html, read via WebFetch). NPC seat terminated 2025-12-27 (公告 第十四号, https://www.news.cn/politics/20251227/c7054b09a1d44338bb0c5f5f275ee033/c.html, fetched).

Xinhua 2026-01-24: 中央政治局委员、中央军委副主席张又侠，中央军委委员、中央军委联合参谋部参谋长刘振立涉嫌严重违纪违法，经党中央研究，决定对张又侠、刘振立立案审查调查. Last public appearance 2025-12-22 (read the promotion order at the ceremony, https://www.news.cn/politics/leaders/20251222/fb1b217000ac46f8812eeaeb3fd5c261/c.html, fetched). Absence noted 2026-01-21 at the provincial-ministerial study session (CNA, https://www.cna.com.tw/news/acn/202601210238.aspx, fetched, secondary). Formal state removal 2026-08-28: 免去张又侠的中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席职务 (https://www.news.cn/politics/20260828/9f7a67c5059e4e7b8a45a8353c5688c8/c.html, fetched); NPC seat terminated same day (公告 第十九号, https://www.news.cn/politics/20260828/880e5ee1563549d99b82c901a20ab62f/c.html, fetched). No successor publicly named through 2026-09-02; the 2026-07-03 ceremony was presided over by 张升民 alone.
